cast_duration.description: Time in seconds the spell casting will take

cooldown_time.description: Time in seconds the mob has to wait before using the spell again

do_casting.description: If true, the mob will do the casting animations and render spell particles

filters.description: Filters allow data objects to specify test criteria which allows their use. Filters can be defined by a single object of type (Filter Test), an array of tests, collection groups, or a combination of these objects.

max_activation_range.description: Upper bound of the activation distance in blocks for this spell, must not be negative.

min_activation_range.description: Lower bound of the activation distance in blocks for this spell, must not be negative.

particle_color.description: The color of the particles for this spell

sequence.description: List of steps for the spell. Each step has the following parameters:

start_sound_event.description: The sound event to play when using this spell

weight.description: The weight of this spell. Controls how likely the mob is to choose this spell when casting one
